CROSS-REFERENCE.

Subject: K. Groehl.

In an intercept letter to Otten, Groehl asks Otten to get him an invitation as he wishes to visit England. The journey money he can manage himself. He also sends further news of Bio.

Original in... PF 45807 Otten 67d. as above. dated.......................
MGH
25.7.38.

S. Form 81.
